data.name: LAKEQUEEN
data.detailed_description:
LAKEQUEEN is a surreal horror pixel adventure game following Samantha, a woman drawn to a Louisiana bayou lake house where memory, superstition, and something alive beneath the water begin to pull her under.

You were only supposed to stay three nights.
A quiet work retreat. A break from the big city.

But this house is strange. And the bayou is stranger.

The trees are watching. The water is listening. The walls are whispering. The air is damp and acrid and suffocating.

Uncover the history.

Resist the panic attacks.

Escape the LAKEQUEEN’s realm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / Apple M2
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 / Apple M1
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
